title: Prawn and mango coconut curry
summary: Prawn and mango coconut curry is a indian dinner built around raw king prawns and mango, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Prawn and mango coconut curry. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add raw king prawns and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and mango.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until light coconut milk is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Prawn and mango coconut curry before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Prawn and mango coconut curry.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
